title: Independent brackish aquifer below the Osiris Shaft

tellings.quote: So, there's a very independent aquifer located directly below the Osiris shaft that is not connected to the Nile River.

plain: Directly beneath the Osiris Shaft, a deep shaft cut into the rock of the Giza plateau in Egypt near the pyramids, there is said to be a separate body of underground water that has no connection to the Nile River. The researcher Jeffrey Drum says this without naming a source. He brings it up as part of his argument that the pyramid site was built around water and worked as some kind of energy system.
